decisions.reason: Removing publisher attribution from the copyright page does not change chapter-image aspect ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The copyright-page attribution decision does not affect Chapter 12 heading, subtitle, punctuation, or capitalization rules.
Removing one copyright-page line does not alter the continuing requirement to provide paperback publication-readiness guidance.
The removed publisher attribution is on the copyright page and does not change the paperback cover's content, presentation, or deliverable requirements.
The source removes publisher attribution from the copyright page, not title-page content or title formatting.
The specific copyright-page deletion does not replace or otherwise change which client manuscript revision is authoritative.
Removing copyright-page publisher attribution does not affect chapter-image inclusion, placement, timing, or full-page treatment.
The copyright-page line removal does not entail any change to body-text paragraph spacing or page-density rules.
The publisher-attribution deletion is unrelated to the italic styling required for Mama's Hot Take text.
The copyright-page decision does not change image selection, chapter mapping, tone fit, or color-palette review criteria.
Removing publisher attribution from the manuscript does not alter the requested KDP metadata-entry, upload, or process-guidance support.
The source decision concerns a discrete copyright-page attribution and does not change the manuscript's editorial objective or approved passage rewrites.
